findings.claim: The change leaves a required acceptance task incomplete while claiming production-readiness convergence.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion task 5 requires saving the source-bound receipt and running quality/OpenSpec checks, but the diff adds `- [ ] 5. Save a source-bound receipt ... run applicable local quality checks and openspec validate ...`.
findings.suggested_fix: Complete the task and mark it checked only after the required receipt and local validation evidence are present, or keep the change open.

findings.claim: The script commits a hardcoded database password, violating the blocking no-hardcoded-secrets constraint.
findings.evidence: Constraint S1 says `No hardcoded secrets ... Secrets come from env / a secret manager`; the script runs Postgres with `-e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=flint-c005` and later embeds `postgres://flint:flint-c005@127.0.0.1:$postgres_port/flint_gate` in generated config.
findings.suggested_fix: Generate a per-run random password or require it from an environment variable, and pass it consistently to Postgres and the generated Gate config without committing a static credential.

findings.claim: Keto tuple deletion builds a query string by interpolation without URL-encoding tuple fields.
findings.evidence: The diff formats `...object={}&relation={}&subject_id={}` directly from `tuple.object`, `tuple.relation`, and `tuple.subject`; subjects originate from verified claims and are unescaped strings.
findings.suggested_fix: Build the request with `reqwest::RequestBuilder::query` or `url::form_urlencoded` so object, relation, and subject values are percent-encoded.
